Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion on your pain around tail latency for search, cost predictability for embeddings, and keeping inference inside your VPC for regulated workloads. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: Redwood can address predictable per-token economics (batching + cache), offer Dedicated pools for data isolation, and a Private deployment option with KMS integration.
- Goal for next meeting: 30-minute product show-and-tell (high level product tour + 10–12 minute ops/security segment) to surface fit for a pilot.

To make scheduling easy, can you pick one of these windows (all PT):
1) Thu, Oct 1 — 10:00–10:30 PT (preferred for our infra lead)
2) Fri, Oct 2 — 11:30–12:00 PT (works for your East Coast folks as well)

If neither works, share two times that do and we’ll adapt. Planned attendees from our side: me (AE), Neha Kapoor (Solutions Engineer), and Olga Petrov (Technical Lead) — Olga will lead the demo and cover deployment/ops questions. Please let us know who will join on your side (security, infra, product).

I attached a short demo agenda and a one-sheet security checklist (we only ask for a couple of pre-demo items). If you can, please fill the security sheet ahead of time — it helps Olga prep targeted answers.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf], [Attachment: bridgewell-security-questions.xlsx]

Looking forward —

--
